title: Sector Nine Rising Anew
author: O. M. Iversen
blurb: Ivo Galloway, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
